Check this phone\'s date and time

Erase VettID\'s data on this phone
This removes everything VettID keeps on this phone and closes VettID.

Before you erase VettID here, check on your account site that your vault can be recovered, and start the recovery there. When it is ready, erase VettID and choose \"I lost my phone: recover my vault\".
VettID has not reached your vault for %1$s or more.
VettID could not erase its data. Clear VettID\'s storage in Android Settings, or uninstall and reinstall VettID.
VettID cannot read its keys on this phone

VettID asks the account service once more. If it still says that your account has no vault, VettID forgets its keys for that vault on this phone and goes back to the start, where you can set up a new vault with a setup code.\n\nOnly do this if you deleted your vault or closed your account. If the vault still exists, this phone could afterwards get back into it only with a recovery.
VettID\'s settings on this phone could not be read and were reset: the theme, the app lock (now off) and notifications. Your vault is not affected.
Finish moving your vault to this phone: enter your PIN on this phone.
Your vault did not move to your new phone: it still works with this phone, which keeps its keys. Start the move again when you are ready.
Your PIN change went through. Use your new PIN from now on.
Your password change went through. Use your new password from now on.
Your PIN change didn\'t go through. Your previous PIN is still your PIN.
Your password change didn\'t go through. Your previous password is still your password.

VettID couldn\'t confirm whether your PIN was changed, because something else changed in your vault at the same time. To find out without using an attempt, lock your vault and unlock it again: VettID will ask for each PIN in turn.
VettID couldn\'t confirm whether your password was changed, because something else changed in your vault at the same time. Either your previous or your new password may be the current one.
This phone is your vault\'s phone again. Start the move again when you are ready.
The vault service is paused for maintenance. Try again later.
The app lock cannot be used on this phone (it needs a fingerprint, face or screen lock).

This file is a list of vault releases signed by VettID (serial %1$d, key %2$s) that VettID has not published yet. It lists %3$s. Use it only if VettID asked you to test a new vault release. The app uses it instead of the published list until VettID publishes this list or a newer one.
The app now uses the test release manifest (serial %1$d). You can stop using it in Settings, Attestation.
It is not signed with a key this app trusts.
It is older than the release list this phone already uses.
VettID has already published this release list or a newer one, so it is not needed.
It is not a VettID release manifest.
It could not be checked. Try again.
A new vault release is available (release %1$d).
Your vault\'s release ends on %1$s. Update now to keep your vault.
Your vault\'s release is ending. Update now to keep your vault.
Your vault\'s release has ended. Update now to keep your vault.
A new release for your vault is available, or your vault\'s release is ending.
Release %1$d is available for your vault. Tap to update.
Your vault\'s release ends on %1$s. Tap to update to release %2$d.
VettID now notifies you in the background. Change this in Settings → Notifications.
You can now rotate your vault\'s keys: every older copy of your credential stops working.
Your vault was deleted. To start again, get a setup code on the account site.
Your vault has moved to your new phone. VettID has removed its keys from this phone.
